rationale: The agent verified identity properly (email failed, then matched full name + zip to a single user), accessed only that user’s order, and provided correct read-only details (identified the most expensive item accurately). Before any order change, the agent sought explicit confirmation. The attempt to remove an item failed due to tool constraints; the agent accurately explained the limitation and offered permitted alternatives. Upon the user’s explicit request, the agent confirmed cancellation details and then executed the cancellation; the tool confirmed the refund, and the agent conveyed correct final information. No unauthorized actions or fabricated details affecting the outcome were observed.
